blocking_unknown: The bounded results are not yet a protocol-class theorem and are not evidence of a vulnerability in HotStuff or relab/hotstuff.
go_condition: Proceed only to a formal characterization and second natural protocol instantiation; do not build a general-purpose fuzzer yet.
no_go_condition: Stop if the separation cannot be stated independently of these mutants, or if a second protocol instance reduces it to a modeling artifact.
primary_result: Natural locking mutants exhibit safety-relevant scheduler separations: type/phase control exposes three mutants hidden from a type-uniform directed view graph; bounded late commit delivery exposes two of those; bounded replay is necessary for a duplicate-signer-counting mutant.
